fields.name: configuration_id
fields.description: Stable project ID such as LAP0001; never a predictor.

fields.name: brand
fields.description: Manufacturer name.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Readable model name; not enough alone to identify a configuration.

fields.name: manufacturer_sku
fields.description: Exact manufacturer part number including suffix; retailer inventory code belongs in offers.

fields.name: cpu_model
fields.description: Exact delivered CPU as sourced; nominal, never an invented performance tier.

fields.name: gpu_model
fields.description: Delivered graphics description; preserve both GPUs if listed.

fields.name: gpu_type
fields.description: Dedicated means a discrete GPU is present, even if integrated graphics also exist; blank if unverified.

fields.name: gpu_vram_gb
fields.description: Verified dedicated VRAM in GB; shared system memory is not dedicated VRAM.

fields.name: ram_gb
fields.description: Delivered RAM in GB, not the supported maximum.

fields.name: ram_type
fields.description: Delivered memory technology as sourced.

fields.name: storage_gb
fields.description: Advertised total internal capacity; use 1000 GB per advertised TB and keep raw text in evidence.

fields.name: storage_type
fields.description: Verified delivered medium; do not equate UFS with an NVMe SSD.

fields.name: screen_inches
fields.description: Display diagonal in inches.

fields.name: display_resolution
fields.description: Verified pixel dimensions such as 1920x1080; preserve unresolved labels in display_text.

fields.name: display_text
fields.description: Display identity including sourced panel type, resolution label, refresh and touch when known.

fields.name: refresh_hz
fields.description: Verified refresh rate; blank does not mean 60 Hz.

fields.name: weight_kg
fields.description: Verified configuration weight in kg; do not use a starting-at or shipping weight as exact.

fields.name: weight_evidence_type
fields.description: Evidence class for weight; no equivalence to independent measurement is implied.

fields.name: evidence_ids
fields.description: Semicolon-separated source evidence IDs supporting these attributes.

fields.name: record_status
fields.description: Only verified records may enter a frozen survey catalogue.

fields.name: review_notes
fields.description: Unresolved fields and corrections; not a predictor.

fields.name: offer_id
fields.description: Immutable observation ID such as OFF0001; a later price needs a new row and ID.

fields.name: configuration_id
fields.description: Foreign key to laptops.configuration_id.

fields.name: retailer
fields.description: Canonical name: Gold One Computer, PTC Computer, or Beckie Khmer for this batch.

fields.name: retailer_sku
fields.description: Shop inventory code; never substitute for a manufacturer SKU.

fields.name: price_usd
fields.description: Observed full purchase price in USD; no installments or zero-price placeholders.

fields.name: currency
fields.description: USD only in the approved catalogue.

fields.name: price_text
fields.description: Short original price notation preserving sale and list-price distinction.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Product URL where available; catalogue URL plus exact SKU anchor otherwise.

fields.name: observed_date
fields.description: Date this evidence was retrieved; does not assert that an indexed page was refreshed that day.

fields.name: availability_text
fields.description: Original stock wording; blank means no explicit stock statement.

fields.name: condition
fields.description: New condition needs evidence; a normal retail listing alone is not explicit confirmation.

fields.name: condition_evidence_id
fields.description: Evidence ID supporting a new-condition decision; required for verified offers.

fields.name: purchase_type
fields.description: Full-price purchase basis; retain installment-only leads in the issue log, not eligible offers.

fields.name: delivered_os
fields.description: Verified delivered OS for this particular offer; OS can differ between shops for the same hardware.

fields.name: snapshot_version
fields.description: Collection version, initially collection_2026-09-28_v0; this is not yet a frozen survey snapshot.

fields.name: evidence_id
fields.description: Foreign key to source_checks.evidence_id.

fields.name: offer_status
fields.description: Only verified eligible offers may be selected for a survey.

fields.name: review_notes
fields.description: Unresolved offer issues; not a predictor.

fields.name: participant_id
fields.description: Anonymous participant code; no name, email, phone or university ID.

fields.name: study_phase
fields.description: Keep pilot and main analysis separate.

fields.name: protocol_version
fields.description: Instrument and consent protocol version in force at collection.

fields.name: consent_status
fields.description: Administrative status; only consented records can provide usable feedback.

fields.name: adult_confirmed
fields.description: 1 when adult participation criterion is confirmed; 0 otherwise.

fields.name: profile_recorded_at
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone; freeze profile before assignment.

fields.name: budget_usd
fields.description: Mandatory maximum USD budget.

fields.name: tasks_json
fields.description: Student-selected or stated tasks as a JSON array of strings; questionnaire vocabulary awaits pilot.

fields.name: software_names
fields.description: Optional stated software; advisory only and not automatic compatibility requirements.

fields.name: major
fields.description: Optional descriptive major; excluded from hardware rules and current model feature plan.

fields.name: min_ram_gb
fields.description: Explicit mandatory RAM minimum; blank means not specified.

fields.name: min_storage_gb
fields.description: Explicit mandatory storage minimum; blank means not specified.

fields.name: max_weight_kg
fields.description: Explicit mandatory weight ceiling; blank means not specified.

fields.name: required_gpu_type
fields.description: Explicit mandatory GPU type; blank means not specified.

fields.name: required_os
fields.description: Explicit delivered-OS requirement; no automatic OS compatibility inference.

fields.name: desired_ram_gb
fields.description: Soft desired RAM target, separate from min_ram_gb.

fields.name: desired_storage_gb
fields.description: Soft desired storage target, separate from min_storage_gb.

fields.name: desired_max_weight_kg
fields.description: Soft preferred maximum weight, separate from max_weight_kg.

fields.name: preferred_screen_inches
fields.description: Soft preferred display diagonal.

fields.name: preferred_gpu_type
fields.description: Soft desired GPU type; blank means unknown or unspecified.

fields.name: importance_savings
fields.description: Preference importance; zero is inactive.

fields.name: importance_ram
fields.description: RAM preference importance; zero is inactive.

fields.name: importance_storage
fields.description: Storage preference importance; zero is inactive.

fields.name: importance_weight
fields.description: Portability preference importance; zero is inactive.

fields.name: importance_screen
fields.description: Screen preference importance; zero is inactive.

fields.name: importance_gpu
fields.description: GPU preference importance; zero is inactive.

fields.name: rating_id
fields.description: Unique observation ID.

fields.name: assignment_id
fields.description: Foreign key to the exact neutral card assignment.

fields.name: participant_id
fields.description: Foreign key to students; must match the assignment.

fields.name: configuration_id
fields.description: Exact configuration judged; must match both offer and assignment.

fields.name: offer_id
fields.description: Exact dated offer shown, never a subsequently refreshed price.

fields.name: snapshot_version
fields.description: Must match the assignment and offer snapshot.

fields.name: rating_status
fields.description: Skips and unable-to-judge responses are missing feedback.

fields.name: suitability_rating
fields.description: Required only for rated responses; blank otherwise; no rule-generated labels.

fields.name: display_order
fields.description: Shown position, copied from assignment.

fields.name: rated_at
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone.

fields.name: comment
fields.description: Optional participant comment; never a predictive feature.

fields.name: assignment_id
fields.description: Unique neutral-card assignment ID.

fields.name: participant_id
fields.description: Foreign key to students.

fields.name: configuration_id
fields.description: Foreign key to laptops; no duplicate configurations per participant.

fields.name: offer_id
fields.description: Frozen selected offer; lowest verified eligible offer for that configuration under the protocol.

fields.name: snapshot_version
fields.description: Frozen snapshot identifier.

fields.name: protocol_version
fields.description: Assignment protocol version.

fields.name: price_budget_band
fields.description: Band computed from observed offer price divided by participant budget.

fields.name: selection_seed
fields.description: Recorded selection seed; no seed chosen by looking at ratings.

fields.name: exposure_count_before
fields.description: Configuration assignment count immediately before this selection.

fields.name: display_order
fields.description: Seeded randomized presentation order.

fields.name: assigned_at
fields.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone.

fields.name: card_version
fields.description: Version of the identical neutral card fields and wording used.

fields.name: evidence_id
fields.description: Unique reference used by laptop and offer rows.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Public page inspected; product-specific URL preferred.

fields.name: page_locator
fields.description: Product name, manufacturer SKU or shop code locating the facts.

fields.name: retrieved_date
fields.description: Date inspected through the retrieval service.

fields.name: access_mode
fields.description: Distinguishes indexed evidence and live manual review; retrieval is not a stock confirmation.

fields.name: facts_observed
fields.description: Compact factual transcription, not a copy of the full webpage.

fields.name: source_check_status
fields.description: Human verification status; automated transcription is pending.

fields.name: checked_by
fields.description: Collector/reviewer code, not a participant identity.

fields.name: checked_at
fields.description: Timezone-aware timestamp of actual manual check.

fields.name: second_check_status
fields.description: Manual second pass; at least 20 percent of retained records across sources and price bands before freeze.

fields.name: second_checked_by
fields.description: Code of person carrying out the second manual pass; may be the solo researcher.

fields.name: second_checked_at
fields.description: Timestamp of that second pass; do not pre-fill.

fields.name: evidence_file
fields.description: Relative path to permitted screenshot or other retained evidence, if actually saved.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Missing fields, discrepancies, retrieval limitations and verification actions.

fields.name: issue_id
fields.description: Unique audit event ID; retain history when resolving.

fields.name: entity_type
fields.description: What is affected.

fields.name: entity_id
fields.description: Configuration ID, offer ID, evidence ID or protocol section.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Source supporting the issue, where applicable.

fields.name: logged_date
fields.description: Date recorded.

fields.name: issue_type
fields.description: Short reason such as storage_conflict or invalid_price.

fields.name: decision
fields.description: Current inclusion decision; resolution must describe evidence.

fields.name: details
fields.description: Observed conflict or reason for exclusion.

fields.name: resolution
fields.description: Evidence-backed resolution, blank while unresolved.
